title.en: How to Clean Up a Blurry Image: From Classical Signal Processing to Large Model-Powered Restoration
title.zh: 如何清理模糊图像：从经典信号处理到大模型驱动的图像复原

description.en: A comprehensive technical guide covering classical deblurring methods, CNN-based deep learning approaches, and modern foundation model techniques for image restoration.
description.zh: 涵盖经典去模糊方法、基于CNN的深度学习方法以及现代大模型技术的图像复原综合技术指南。
